title: EEG: Visual Working Memory + Cabergoline Challenge
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from a visual working memory task administered under a double-blind, placebo-controlled Cabergoline (1.25 mg) drug challenge. Thirty healthy participants (27 completers) were tested across two sessions, with drug order counterbalanced. The data were collected circa 2012-2013 at the Laboratory for Neural Computation & Cognition at Brown University, with the EEG data previously unpublished.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during a visual working memory task in a double-blind, crossover design with cabergoline (1.25 mg) or placebo administration. Thirty healthy participants were enrolled with 27 completing both sessions. Data were collected circa 2012-2013 at the Laboratory for Neural Computation & Cognition at Brown University.
